episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In the courtyards of the Summerhouse Estate, a thriving but underground drugs business is being run by Dushane and his friend Sully.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Raikes gives Sully and Dushane two weeks to retrieve the stash stolen by rival Kamale and they find a mysterious present of guns to help them.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After Heather has shown him the flat she hopes to buy with her drug money, Ra'Nell welcomes his mother home. Sully visits his daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Dushane is shocked that Sully still has the gun that killed three people but refuses to go along with Raikes's plan to sell him out as a liability.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Under the wing of his boss, "Top Boy" Dushane faces a new rival: his one-time friend Sully. Meanwhile, Ra'Nell's mother tries to rebuild her life.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While visiting the injured Joe, Dushane discovers who stole their drugs. Meanwhile, Mike and Sully botch a hit, and police descend on Summerhouse.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Sully asks for a sit-down with Dushane, and Rafe swears vengeance on Sully and Mike, who abducted his younger brother, Jermaine.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Gem's father retaliates against Vincent for beating Ra'Nell, and Dushane and Sully reunite to retrieve the stolen drugs from the Albanians.
